marketing_description: The DeWALT Xtreme Series DCF513EB ratchet delivers 75 ft‑lb of torque from a 20 V Li‑Ion battery in a compact 3/8‑in square drive, with a variable speed range of 0‑250 RPM controlled by a trigger switch. Its open‑head design and LED work light provide extended reach and visibility for overhead applications, while the brushless motor enhances efficiency and runtime.
